The appointment follows the resignation of P N Vasudevan as managing director and chief executive officer of the bank, citing investor concerns over a perceived conﬂict of interest arising from his daughter’s association with a non-banking ﬁnancial company. As the executive director, Nuthalapadi has played a pivo- tal role in enhancing digital capabilities, upgrading tech- nology and improving oper- ational efficiency. Prior to join- ing Equitas Small Finance Bank Limited, Nuthalapadi was with Citi for 28 years and served as managing director and head of India citi solutions centers and head of India oper- ations and technology. He worked in multiple geo- graphies across Asia and EMEA in roles spanning asset sales, wealth management, re-engin- eering, consumer operations and technology and Global Capability Center leadership where he led the scale-up of Citi’s global hubs in India. Nuthalapadi's appoint- ment will take effect from the date of RBI approval or such other date as may be stipulated by the RBI. Equitas shall ensure to its stakeholders and inves- tors that smooth and seamless transition which connote sta- bility, said a statement. The Board has placed on record its deep appreciation and sincere gratitude to Vasudevan for his invaluable contributions, exemplary leadership and dedicated service to the Bank during his tenure.
